caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure dressed in a green outfit, with a red sash or belt and yellow accents at the waist and wrist. The figure has dark brown skin and long, reddish-brown hair, visible under a green headdress adorned with three upright feathers in yellow, green, and red colors. The figure's left hand holds a red rectangular box with rows of small vertical elements, while the right hand rests on a long, narrow object, possibly a staff, that touches the ground. The clothing includes a knee-length tunic with jagged edges at the hem. The figure stands on a round, textured base resembling a cut tree stump. The drawing is rendered in colored pencils or pastels on a light beige background, and the name "Adele Brooks" is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
